name: batch-geocoder
description: Turn a list of place names into coordinates (latitude, longitude, country, timezone) with the free Open-Meteo geocoding API, politely rate-limited, and save the result as CSV.

input_file.description: Text file with one place per line. Add ', XX' to restrict to a country code, e.g. 'Springfield, US'.

language.description: Language for place names in the result (en, zh, de, fr, ...)

steps.run: node -e 'const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_INPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const lines = require("fs").readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith("#")); const places = lines.map((query, i) => { const m = query.match(/^(.*?),\s*([A-Za-z]{2})$/); return { n: i + 1, query, name: m ? m[1].trim() : query, country: m ? m[2].toUpperCase() : "" } }); console.log(JSON.stringify(places))'

node -e 'const p = JSON.parse(process.env.PLACE); const q = new URLSearchParams({ name: p.name, count: "1", language: process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_LANGUAGE, format: "json" }); if (p.country) q.set("countryCode", p.country); const attempt = n => fetch("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?" + q, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) }).then(r => { if (r.status === 429 && n < 3) return new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 2000 * n)).then(() => attempt(n + 1)); if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json() }); attempt(1).then(d => { const g = (d.results || [])[0]; console.log(JSON.stringify(g ? { query: p.query, found: true, name: g.name, region: g.admin1 || "", country: g.country || g.country_code, lat: g.latitude, lon: g.longitude, timezone: g.timezone, population: g.population || "" } : { query: p.query, found: false })) }, e => console.log(JSON.stringify({ query: p.query, found: false, error: e.name === "Error" ? e.message : e.name })))'

node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const rows = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).map(r => r.geo); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OUTPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); const cols = ["query", "found", "name", "region", "country", "lat", "lon", "timezone", "population"]; const csv = v => /[",
]/.test(String(v)) ? "\x22" + String(v).replace(/"/g, "\x22\x22") + "\x22" : String(v); fs.writeFileSync(file, [cols.join(","), ...rows.map(r => cols.map(c => csv(r[c] == null ? "" : r[c])).join(","))].join("
") + "
"); const found = rows.filter(r => r.found); const missing = rows.filter(r => !r.found); const lines = ["📍 Geocoded " + found.length + " of " + rows.length + " places → " + file]; found.slice(0, 8).forEach(r => lines.push("• " + r.query + " → " + r.name + ", " + r.country + " (" + r.lat.toFixed(3) + ", " + r.lon.toFixed(3) + ")")); if (found.length > 8) lines.push("…"); missing.forEach(r => lines.push("❓ Not found: " + r.query + (r.error ? " (" + r.error + ")" : ""))); console.log(lines.join("
"))'
